description:
Create or update an app draft on Nativine.

USAGE & SELECTION FLOW:
1. If the user wants to start a FRESH NEW DRAFT, omit draftId (or pass a new generated draftId) so a clean draft is created.
2. If the user selected an existing app draft from nativine_list_drafts, pass its draftId to update it.

FREE DEMO vs PRO RELEASE PLAN:
- Free Plan: Generates trial test APKs for basic WebView testing.
- Pro / Release Plan: Unlocks AAB (Google Play Store bundle), iOS IPA compilation, Push Notifications (OneSignal), AdMob ads, Biometrics, and Custom Keystore signing.
If a user requests premium features without a Release Plan, notify the user: "This feature can be configured in your draft, but requires a Pro/Release Plan to compile production builds. Upgrade anytime at https://nativine.com/pricing".

REQUIRED FIELDS (for new drafts):
- appName: Display name (2-50 chars)
- appUrl: Target website URL (https://...)
- packageName: Android package ID (e.g. "com.company.app")

CONFIG OBJECT — All fields are optional, merge with existing config:

BRANDING:
  brandColor (hex "#635BFF") — Primary accent color
  brandColorDark (hex) — Dark variant
  brandColorLight (hex) — Light variant
  statusBarColor (hex "#FFFFFF") — Android status bar
  navBarColor (hex "#FFFFFF") — Android navigation bar
  splashBackgroundColor (hex "#FFFFFF")

SPLASH SCREEN:
  splashType ("logo" | "full" | "animation") — Splash screen style
  splashLogoSize ("140") — Logo size in px
  splashAnimationType ("bounce" | "fade" | "pulse")

BEHAVIOR:
  screenOrientation ("portrait" | "landscape" | "both")
  enablePullToRefresh (boolean) — Pull to reload page
  enableProgressBar (boolean) — Loading bar at top
  enablePinchToZoom (boolean)
  pressAgainToExit (boolean) — Double-back to exit
  enableFullScreen (boolean) — Hide system bars
  disableCaching (boolean)
  disableBackButton (boolean)
  enableCachePurge (boolean)

PERMISSIONS:
  enableCamera (boolean)
  enableMicrophone (boolean)
  enableLocation (boolean)
  enableStorage (boolean)
  cameraDescription (string) — Permission dialog text
  micDescription (string)
  locationDescription (string)
  storageDescription (string)

WEB OVERRIDES:
  userAgent (string) — Custom User-Agent header
  customCSS (string) — CSS injected into every page
  customJS (string) — JS injected into every page
  supportedDomains (string) — Comma-separated allowed domains

DEEP LINKS:
  enableDeepLinks (boolean)
  deepLinkScheme (string "myapp") — URL scheme
  enableUniversalLinks (boolean)
  openExternalBrowser (boolean)

ADDONS (boolean toggles + related config):
  enableBottomNav — Native bottom tab navigation bar
  enableHeader — Native header action bar
  enableFloatingBtn — Floating action button overlay
  enableOneSignal + oneSignalAppId — Push notifications
  enableAdMob + adMobAppId, bannerAdId, interstitialAdId, rewardedAdId, appOpenAdId — Ad monetization
  enableBiometrics — Fingerprint/Face ID app lock
  enableHapticFeedback — Tactile vibrations via JS bridge
  enableInAppUpdates — Prompt to update app from Play Store
  enableInAppReviews — Prompt to review on Play Store
  enableLocalDatastore — Persistent key-value storage
  enableContactsAccess — Native contacts API
  enablePrintSupport — Print web pages natively
  enableOAuthSupport + googleSignInWebClientId — Google/social login
  enableScreenshotBlocker — Block screenshots

KEYSTORE (Release plan only):
  useCustomKeystore (boolean)
  keystorePassword (string)
  keystoreAlias (string)
  keyPassword (string)

VERSION:
  versionCode ("1") — Internal version number
  versionName ("1.0.0") — Display version string

NOTE: The backend enforces plan restrictions. Free plan users cannot use premium addons,
custom keystore, deep links, or web overrides. The server strips these at build time.
Paid addons (biometrics, haptics, etc.) require purchase through the Nativine checkout.

addons.description: Array of addon IDs: onesignal, admob, bottomnav, header, floatingbtn, biometrics, haptics, inappupdates, inappreviews, localstore, contacts, print, oauth, screenshot

config.description: Configuration object — see tool description for all available fields

draftId.description: Draft ID. Omit to create new (generates draft_<timestamp>). Reads from .nativine/config.json if available.

name: nativine_save_draft
